title: Simple Invoice Data Extractor
description:
Small businesses and freelancers collect invoices and receipts as photos, scans and PDFs, and copy amounts, dates and vendor names into a spreadsheet by hand. The goal is a simple tool that reads these documents with OCR and writes the key data into Excel.

  • Input: images (JPG, PNG), PDFs and text files, one folder at a time.
  • Fields: vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, subtotal, tax, total, currency.
  • Runs locally, without a cloud account.
  • Shows clearly which documents need a manual check.
goals:
• Invoice number, date and total found on at least 90 % of clean, typed invoices in a test set of your own documents.
  • A folder of 50 documents processed in a few minutes on a normal laptop.
  • Every row with a missing or inconsistent value (for example subtotal + tax not equal to total) is marked in the Excel file.
